answers.crispy: Pat ingredients dry and add a light coating of flour or starch. Fry in small batches so the oil stays hot, then drain on a wire rack. Add wet sauces just before serving.
answers.plating: Choose a plate that leaves a little space around the food. Build a small amount of height, add one contrasting colour, and wipe the rim. Soft light from a window makes a lovely finishing touch.
answers.balance: Taste a small spoonful first. If it is too sweet, try a little lemon juice or vinegar; if it is too salty, add more unsalted ingredients. Make one small adjustment at a time and taste again.
answers.pasta: Cook pasta in salted water and check the texture before the packet time is up. Save a cup of the cooking water. Toss the pasta with your sauce and a splash of that water until the sauce coats it.
answers.dinner: Try a quick bowl: rice or noodles, a protein you enjoy, and two vegetables. Use lemon, olive oil and herbs for a simple dressing. Start with whatever is already in your kitchen.
answers.baking: Weigh your ingredients and preheat the oven before you begin. Once flour goes into a cake batter, mix only until combined. Let baked goods cool before decorating so the topping stays in place.
answers.vegetables: Dry vegetables well, cut them into similar sizes and give them space on the tray. Roast until the edges colour, turning as needed. Finish with lemon and herbs for a brighter flavour.

supportArticles.question: Where can I get more coins?
supportArticles.answer: Open My wallet from your profile for coin packs and Apple prices. Daily check-ins also add reward coins.

supportArticles.question: My coins have not arrived
supportArticles.answer: If Apple shows Pending, wait for approval. If a completed payment has no coins, contact support with your Apple order details. Check your balance before buying again.

supportArticles.question: What can I do on the call screen?
supportArticles.answer: Messages and call preparation require mutual follows. Voice calls request microphone access; video calls request camera and microphone access and show your own camera preview. No call connects to another person yet, and your camera and microphone are not shared.

supportArticles.question: How can I change my language?
supportArticles.answer: Open Settings, then Language. Choose English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German or Japanese. Your choice updates the interface immediately and is saved for your next visit.

supportArticles.question: Where is my saved content?
supportArticles.answer: Your profile holds your videos, rewards and room-effect history. Logging out keeps them. Deleting your profile removes its records and imported files from Tati.
